answer: Require every new identity to be sponsored by an established agent who locks a refundable stake behind it: the stake is the saffron thread tying a newcomer to a real reputation. A sponsor who vouches for a fake forfeits the bond, so growing a grove of Sybil identities costs the attacker a forest of lost stakes. Honest newcomers earn the stake back once they prove themselves, turning the oasis of free signups into ground where fake identities are simply too expensive to farm.
